Carla (Support): Heads up — customers reporting invoice spikes for 2026-03-14 region eu-west1. Dashboard token counts do NOT match invoices (+~18% billed). Opening thread so billing + infra can triage.
Ben (Billing): Which invoices/customers? any correlation to plan or routing?
Carla (Support): Two enterprise accounts (acct-2487, acct-9912) called in. Billing dashboard shows expected token ~1.2M, invoice shows 1.4M. Also saw a small cluster of support tickets referencing higher charges.
Ben (Billing): Ok. I pulled the raw events for acct-2487 — invoice tokens = 1,402,120; event-store tokens sum = 1,203,012. Gap ~199,108 tokens.
Alice (Eng-SRE): Did we have any pipeline events or deploys around 2026-03-14 23:00 UTC? Could be duplication in ingestion.
Dan (Runtime): There was a transient pause in event-forwarder at 2026-03-14T22:58Z due to a config reload. Re-ingest worker restarted afterwards.
Emma (Support): Support tickets show customers made no unusual number of requests. They provided sample request IDs.
billing-bot: Alert: ingestion-delay > 30m detected at 2026-03-14T23:05Z.
Alice (Eng-SRE): I pulled a few rows from event-store. I see duplicate event_ids for the same request id: e.g. `req_7b3f..` appears twice with identical token_count 512. Sample: `event_id: ev_00123, request_id: req_7b3f, token_count: 512, ts: 2026-03-14T23:10:12Z` AND `event_id: ev_00999, request_id: req_7b3f, token_count: 512, ts: 2026-03-14T23:10:14Z`.
Dan (Runtime): That matches my suspicion — on restart the re-ingest worker didn't apply idempotency checks for ~6 minutes due to a missing flag in the new release (we shipped `reingest-v2` with `--idempotency=false` by default).
Carla (Support): So invoices are counting duplicate events? Would billing dedupe later or rely on event-store raw counts?
Ben (Billing): Our billing pipeline sums raw ingested token events. If duplicates landed in event-store, they will be reflected in invoices unless we run a reconciliation.
Alice (Eng-SRE): Proposed immediate actions: 1) stop any further re-ingests (`kubectl scale deployment reingest-v2 --replicas=0`), 2) run a dedup pass to mark duplicates (`scripts/dedupe_events --since 2026-03-14T22:55Z --key=request_id`), 3) generate a reconciliation report mapping invoice tokens -> cleaned token_total.
Dan (Runtime): Command we plan to run (dry-run):
```
./tools/reingest --mode=repair --since="2026-03-14T22:55:00Z" --dedup=true --out=/tmp/recon-2026-03-14.json
```
ops-bot: Job reingest-repair-179112 started (dry-run).
billing-bot: Triggering invoice-hold for affected customers (acct-2487, acct-9912) pending reconciliation.
Ben (Billing): Thanks. If the dedupe shows duplicates = ~200k tokens for acct-2487, we'll issue a pro-rated credit on next invoice and update accounting. Need audit log for customer communication.
Emma (Support): I'll update the affected tickets and offer interim credits if required. Can someone post the recon output (CSV) once ready?
Alice (Eng-SRE): Dry-run finished. Found ~210,432 duplicate tokens across 3 enterprise accounts and ~8 smaller customers. Output: `/tmp/recon-179112-dry.csv`. Sample CSV header: `customer_id,invoice_tokens,raw_tokens,dup_tokens,clean_tokens`.
Dan (Runtime): Root cause: reingest-v2 default flag regression. We're rolling a patch to set `--idempotency=true` and will redeploy at 03:15 UTC after thermal window.
Carla (Support): What's the plan for invoices already issued?
Ben (Billing): We'll hold automatic invoice finalizations for affected accounts, issue adjustments/credit memos, and notify finance. I'll prepare the credit memos once we have final cleaned token counts.
Alice (Eng-SRE): Action items: [Alice] run final dedupe pass (non-dry) at 03:00 UTC, [Dan] deploy patched reingest-v2 at 03:15 UTC, [Ben] prepare credit memos, [Emma/Carla] update customers. Also add post-incident doc.
Emma (Support): I'll draft email template and post it in #support-templates.
ops-bot: Reingest job completed (repair): 2026-03-15T03:05Z. Output: `/var/logs/recon-179112-final.csv`.
Alice (Eng-SRE): Final numbers: total duplicate tokens removed = 214,890. Affected invoices adjusted: acct-2487 (-198,450 tokens), acct-9912 (-9,120 tokens), acct-5563 (-7,320 tokens).
Ben (Billing): Processing credits now. I'll tag finance and send docs to legal for any SLA/dispute risk.
Carla (Support): Closing customer tickets after confirmation from billing. Thanks team. :thumbsup: 
Dan (Runtime): Adding a CI test for `--idempotency` default and a monitoring alert for duplicate request_id rate.
Alice (Eng-SRE): Postmortem todo: timeline, root cause, mitigation, and an automated reconciliation job to run after any ingestion outage. I'll start the doc and link here: https://redwood.internal/ops/postmortems/179112-usage-gap-audit
Ben (Billing): Closing loop — will update once credits are posted and customers notified.
Carla (Support): Marking thread resolved unless anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
